schema: data/moves v1 (style of throwdown.json): every number = {v, basis}; basis = sample id + skeleton field + frame/time
conventions: ref angles: knee 0 = straight, torso_lean 0 = upright, arm_abd 0 = arm hanging, elbow 0 = straight (MediaPipe skeleton). game.* knee = interior angle (180 = straight) as in rider.js. t = clip time (0 = user segment start).
other_sources: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_3 (4分, same rider, 2.8 s) for a second look
segment_notes: 2.0 s user segment, one 360 deg turn on the board (vision on the mp4: back to camera 0-0.9 s, facing the camera ~1.0-1.5 s, back again by ~1.6-1.9 s). The knee main peak (knee_L ~88-126 deg at t 1.6-1.9) is NOT part of the spin: one heel kicks up behind her as she exits (vision sees the RIGHT heel; MediaPipe left/right is unreliable seen from behind, stats.shoulder_facing_flips = 9). Use the spin window t 0.4-1.45 for knees. Shoulder yaw from world coords flips sign with the detector, so turn timing comes from image facing (lm shoulder order).

stance.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 refskel stance(): travel method (向画面左), ankle order in t 0..0.5, 11/11 frames agree with view.stance

windup_t.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 ang.torso_lean peak in t<=0.45 (wind-up lean) f10 t0.23 (smoothed 22.4, raw 22.5, half-height -0.0..0.3)

windup_torso_lean_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 ang.torso_lean peak in t<=0.45 f10 t0.23 (smoothed 22.4, raw 22.5, half-height -0.0..0.3)

windup_arm_abd_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 ang.arm_abd_max median (arms open before the turn) over t -0.1..0.1

pull_in_t.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 ang.wrist_span min in t 0.45..0.9 (arms gathered to the chest during the turn; they already close to 0.2-0.3 m at t 0.37-0.6) f17 t0.47 (smoothed 0.3, raw 0.3, half-height 0.3..0.7)

pull_in_wrist_span_m.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 ang.wrist_span min in t 0.45..0.9 f17 t0.47 (smoothed 0.3, raw 0.3, half-height 0.3..0.7)

open_wrist_span_m.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 ang.wrist_span median (arms re-open, facing camera) over t 1.0..1.45

half_turn_t.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 lm shoulder order (img facing = (lm11.x-lm12.x)/torso length, smoothed) first > 0.3 after t 0.3 = she faces the camera = 180 deg

turn_start_t.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 lm shoulder order |facing| falls from ~1.0 (t 0.1) to ~0.1 at t 0.5 — rotation starts ~0.45 (vision: tiles 3-4 of the 6 fps sheet)

turn_end_t.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 vision on the mp4 (back to camera again by ~1.6 s); lm facing flips back at f47-f50 (t 1.47-1.57)

knee_spin_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 ang.knee_max median during the spin over t 0.4..1.45

knee_spin_min_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 ang.knee_max min during the spin (rise) f22 t0.63 (smoothed 17.2, raw 17.5, half-height -0.1..0.73)

torso_spin_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 ang.torso_lean median during the spin (upright) over t 0.4..1.45

ankle_dist_m.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 ang.ankle_dist median (feet close at centre) over t 0.4..1.45

exit_kick_knee_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_36 ang.knee_L peak after the spin (heel kick on exit; side uncertain) f52 t1.63 (smoothed 88.3, raw 99.6, half-height 1.6..1.93)

game._: proposed rider.js params for a body pirouette on a rolling board (board keeps its heading). Not wired yet.

pullInAt.basis: (ref.pull_in_t - ref.turn_start_t) / spinT: phase of max gather

speedLoss.basis: not measurable from the skeleton (no board); docs/moves.md "slows a little" — placeholder, ask exporter for board speed
